issues.description: The DealScan-to-RSSD crosswalk is an independently imported workbook; its underlying source, delivery route, and mapping coverage are not established in the supplied package.

The sample builder imports a separate manual workbook containing AcquiringBank and AG_above_20, but the classification rule and completed workbook are not supplied in the registered package inventory.

The Granger stage reads the permanent build.banksreturn member. The supplied return-preparation source creates a same-named WORK table but does not establish that exact persisted build-library product; its producer/path mapping needs confirmation.
The systemic-risk stage separately imports srisk_vlab and mes; the required series, source fields, period, and identifier mapping are not established by the supplied program text.
The supplied programs embed Windows Dropbox roots and file-level paths across SAS and Stata calls, so an execution copy needs a coherent portable project-root and library setup.

The active trim_by_year macro consumes trimlist_rank, but the complete SAS statements that define its producer are masked in the safe view. Its variables and exact source table need a schema-level confirmation.
The supplied programs require SAS procedures from SAS/STAT and SAS/ETS, while the registered safe environment viewer leaves SAS unverified. This audit did not launch SAS.
The Stata driver uses outreg2, and the exact-name software probe returned available=false under Stata 18.

evidence.description: The README attributes the supplied code to the registered paper title.
evidence.quote: This document describes the codes used to generate the final output for “The Spillover Effect of Liquidity Transparency on Liquidity Holdings” by Yao Lu.

evidence.description: The README states the programs are ordered and run sequentially.
evidence.quote: The codes are saved in three folders that are sorted by folder names. Within each folder, the codes are further sorted by their file names. The codes should be run sequentially to generate the final output.

evidence.description: The README lists the supplied Compile, Build, and Analysis programs, including the separate aggregate-effect program.
evidence.quote:
Folder “00_Compile”
Folder “00_CoVaR”: Construct CoVaR measures
01_CoVaR_Input.sas: Compile raw data on macroeconomic conditions for forward-looking CoVaR calculation.
02_BankRet.sas: Compile raw data on bank-level stock returns for CoVaR calculation.
03_ForwardCoVaRPredictors_banklevel.sas: Compile raw data on bank financials for forward-looking CoVaR calculation.
04_CoVaR_Calculation.sas: Calculate CoVaR using inputs generated in the previous steps.
05_ForwardCoVaRCalculation_outofsample.sas: Calculate forward-looking CoVaR using inputs generated in the previous steps.
99_Macros.sas: This file contains macros used by other code files in this folder and does not need to be run independently.
01_BHCData.sas: Compile raw data (FR Y-9C filings) on bank financials into a single panel.
Folder “01_Build”
01_BuildNW.sas: Build the bank interaction network based on syndicated loan transactions using DealScan data.
02_NW_structure_BHC.sas: Create measures of the bank interaction network structure.
03_CreateVariables.sas: Create variables of bank financials.
04_NWDetails.sas: Combine datasets on bank interaction network structure and bank financials to create the sample for the main analysis.
05_PSM.sas: Create the propensity-score-matched (PSM) sample for additional analysis based on the PSM sample. 
06_bankpairs.sas: Create the bank pair sample for additional analysis on the determinants of co-syndication relationships.
07_corr_connect.sas: Construct the Granger Causality measure.
08_SystemicRisk.sas: Combine the CoVaR and Granger Causality datasets to create the sample for the systemic risk analysis.
Folder “02_Analysis”
01_AllCombined_tex.do: Generate the final output (except for the aggregate effect table) reported in the paper.
02_AggregateEffect.sas: Generate the aggregate effect table.

evidence.description: The author datasheet names FR Y-9C, DealScan, CRSP, CBOE VIX, Bloomberg repo, and Federal Reserve sources.
evidence.quote:
I obtained the raw data from the following sources: financial data for bank holding companies from FR Y-
9C reports (downloaded on March 15th, 2020), syndicated loan data from Thomson-Reuters’ LPC DealScan
(downloaded on October 1st, 2018), market data for listed bank holding companies from the Center for
Research in Security Prices (downloaded on July 29th, 2020), VIX data from the CBOE (downloaded on
April 3rd, 2023), the three-month general collateral repo rate data from Bloomberg (downloaded on April
3rd, 2023), and other macroeconomic data from the Federal Reserve (downloaded on April 3rd, 2023).

evidence.description: The datasheet identifies the three program folders and the supplied sample identifier workbook.
evidence.quote:
The computer programs are saved in three folders under the code folder. The first folder, “00_Compile,”
contains codes that compile raw data into initial panels. The second folder, “01_Build,” contains codes that
produce the final samples. The third folder, “02_Analysis,” contains codes that generate the tables of the
manuscript. The codes should be run sequentially to generate the final output. The code folder also includes
a list of the identifiers (RSSD9001) in the file “Identifiers.xlsx” for my final sample and a description of
the codes in a “readme.docx” file.

review_notes: The cumulative correction covers the supplied full_pipeline and all 16 entry points; every one of the 75 frozen dependency IDs retains exactly one review disposition. The sole registered workbook is an identifier list, not the banklist, DealScan-RSSD crosswalk, manual flags, or a prepared analysis panel; no analysis_only scope is supported.

The successful local CRSP.DSI probe has both DATE and VWRETD; the raw value-weighted series is available with ordinary DATE-to-CALDT mapping. The successful CRSP.DSF probe has PERMNO/PERMCO/DATE/RET/PRC/SHROUT. The banklist join remains independent; the real-estate and bank-stock subset selections remain specific unresolved inputs.

Successful local DealScan COMPANY, FACILITY, and LENDERSHARES probes contain every declared consumed raw field, including facility dates and lender role/allocation/agent/lead-arranger fields. These local raw components are credited; row coverage and author release provenance are ordinary preparation checks.

Cboe documents daily VIX closing values and FRED DBAA documents the daily Moody's Baa yield, so both public routes are credited for ordinary acquisition/header/date preparation. The interest-rate input remains conditional on the exact TB3M measure; DGS3MO is not assumed equivalent to a discount-yield series.

The FRB.RATES_DAILY successful bounded probe supports date/DBAA as a local candidate. Its failed exact-field request remains preserved as an unused top-level evidence record; it is not referenced scientifically and does not establish data absence or a product/access barrier.

The FR Y-9C historical member schema, DealScan-RSSD mapping, banklist, manual acquisition flags, SRISK/MES measures and mappings, active trimlist_rank producer, SAS runtime, and WORK-versus-build banksreturn handoff remain specifically identified preparation or clarification steps.

The 24 source quotes containing private author roots were narrowed to literal screened line excerpts outside those roots; path-only records were removed where no substantive excerpt was needed. Source files, probes, source views, and earlier helpers remain unchanged; prior input and output copies are byte-exact and mode 0444.

The SAS safe view retains original line numbering and masks complete candidate-bearing statements and continuations in 99_Macros.sas at lines 37-40, 59-62, and 83-86. The active trim_by_year consumer remains visible; trimlist_rank remains unresolved, while the uncalled trim_harris lists remain optional.

The first saved source-view invocation failed because --path was omitted; its empty output, actual CLI stderr, and helper copy remain preserved. Author .txt/.smcl logs remain metadata-only; no raw log or generated log view was displayed or used as program evidence, so no log-only completion claim is made.

The conditional run procedure preserves the documented CoVaR sequence, BHCData preparation, sequential Build stages, Stata main analysis, and separate SAS AggregateEffect branch. It does not establish an undocumented cross-branch order or collapse unresolved input handoffs.

No author code, SAS executable, statistical procedure, dataset-wide descriptive trial, parser, or model was run for this correction. No new resource probe or data download was performed. execution_verified remains false.
